deferred.reason: Moving drill rig uses waypoints and direction-specific working layers; the base alone is incomplete.
Separate moving carriage, drill and status layers need a dedicated rig.
Warm-up, working and cooldown states need coordinated multi-part animation.
Rolling stock, track geometry and vehicle orientation need dedicated scene support.
Walking, attacking and aiming need explicit state and direction rigs.
